scenes.headline: How a looped Transformer keeps solving a scene
scenes.sub: Solv3R turns one shared block into a solver
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Jacobi! Today, a 3D reconstruction model that never has to start over.

scenes.text: Make the loop stationary: one shared block with no step index, trained so a solved scene stays solved and new views join a running solve.
scenes.say: One shared block with no step index, trained so a solved scene stays solved and new views can join a running solve.

scenes.title: Two ways to loop a block

left.title: Step-conditioned loop
items: Each step applies a different update
left.say: The parent model loops a block too, but tells it which step it is on.

right.title: Stationary loop
items: Views at any stage update together
right.say: This one applies the same update every call, like the Jacobi method, so views at any stage update together.

steps.say: A frozen encoder turns each image into tokens: the initial state, which holds the constraints.
Each call, one shared block attends within each view, then across all views, with the initial state injected again.
The whole state is rescaled to a fixed size, so it cannot drift over many calls.
Loop as long as you like. Decode cameras and depth after any call, and add new views whenever they arrive.

scenes.title: Training it to be a solver
scenes.say: Stationary is not convergent, so the solver behaviour is trained.

items.say: First, run a random number of calls without gradients.
Sometimes add noise, or reset some views, like new views joining.
Then eight calls with gradients, and supervise only the last one.

steps.say: Four views are solved, then twelve more join. The old views keep their state.
The solver keeps improving the original views and brings the new ones in. The step-conditioned parent does not.

scenes.title: Cache per held map view
scenes.note: rebuilt from token and layer counts
scenes.say: With no step index, one cache of keys and values works at every call. Sixteen times smaller than its parent's.

scenes.text: Make the loop stationary, then train it to have a solver's properties. Continuing, adding views and caching all follow.
scenes.say: Make the loop stationary, then train in a solver's properties. The rest follows.

recap: One shared block, no step index
New views join a running solve
scenes.say: One block, no step index. Solved scenes stay solved, and new views join the solve.
